manifest.name: @comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information
manifest.description: DSH plugin: richer session hover cards — corner icons that copy the session id and workspace path, plus a configurable metrics block (turns, steps, tokens, compactions, context, subagents, …) fed by the hoverInfo projection + Typert remote, gated by the bundle row's own configuration page on the Plugins page
manifest.author: Robe ComeCaramelos <hello@comecaramelos.com>

bundle.text:
# @comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information — bundle patch.
#
# Host plane: one profile entry row named after the plugin's own id.
# `id: hover-info` is not decoration — it is the key every part of the
# configuration surface resolves by: the host form attaches the entry by this
# row's id (not a bundle id), and the browser reads and writes the entry's
# configuration form through the very same id. The row also mounts the
# `hoverInfo` projection unit and the `hoverInfo` Typert remote from its
# `apply`, so no further patch lines are needed for them (docs/PLAN.md §36).
#
# Deliberately NO `config:` block here. Every field answers its own default in
# the Config schema, and the row's `config:` is the layer the Host answers as
# the document's OWN base — so whatever is declared here is what a later form
# write re-materialises as a user-layer value. Pinning `active: true` here was
# measured (when that field still existed — the master switch is gone since
# docs/PLAN.md §40) to make that switch come back Overridden after one unrelated
# toggle: the write answered `{active: true, showToolCalls: true}` for a single
# `showToolCalls` op. What the row needs is its id and name; the defaults come
# from the schema, and the user layer then says only what the user actually
# changed (docs/PLAN.md §36).
- insert:
    - id: hover-info
      name: "@comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information"

readme.text:
Aditional info in web UI.

**Preview card**

Configurable metrics block, configured on this bundle's own configuration page
on the Plugins page (turning the bundle row off is what disables the whole
enhancement):

- **Copy session ID** / **Copy workspace path** icons on the card's header
  row — `⧉ copy ID` / `⧉ copy path` beside the status dot and the relative
  time, instead of the stock whole-card copy button.
- **Metrics block**: turns, steps, tokens sent/received, cache tokens,
  compactions, purges (tool-result prunes), context window, subagents, model,
  tool calls, active time and created date — toggled per metric.

**Model selector**

- **Provider in the selector**: tooltip and visible value read
  `Provider > Model`.

From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information
```

Manual install — the live profile installs the **published** package, so it is
just a manifest entry (materialized by `pnpm install` inside the profile; no
`link:`, no symlink there):

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information": "link:/path/to/dsh-hover-information"
  },

Then restart the `web` host — browser bundles don't hot-update, and
the live `dsh web` gateway is never restarted by tooling.

The row card is built on the shared base layer
[`@comecaramelos/dsh-ancesters`](https://github.com/ComeCaramelos/dsh-ancesters),
linked as a sibling checkout (`file:../dsh-ancesters`) — build it first.

```sh
npm install
npm run build      # tsc (host) + tsc typecheck + esbuild (browser) → lib/
npm test           # builds first, then node --test
```

Sources live in `src/host/**` (host half) and `src/client/**` (browser half);
`src/index.ts` is the host's re-export-only face, and `scripts/build-client.mjs`
collapses the browser half into one `lib/client.js` lazy-CJS bundle. `lib/` is
build output and is git-ignored. Every consumer —
the profile row, the browser bundle and the tests — resolves it through
`package.json#exports`, so run the build after editing sources and before
pointing a profile checkout at this tree. See [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) 
for the layout and the verification recipe.
